sessions.prompt:
Add parse_hm(s) to clock.py: a time such as "09:30" becomes minutes after midnight (570). Add tests.

The plan for parse_hm has one more step: it also accepts 12-hour times with am or pm ("1:15pm" becomes 795, "12:05am" becomes 5). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a shift must end after it starts (no shift runs past midnight): any function given an end time that is not after the start time raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: overtime starts after 40 paid hours in a week.

given.handoff: Session 1 added parse_hm(s) with tests. Its last step is left for later: accept 12-hour times with am or pm.
decisions: A shift must end after it starts: an end time not after the start raises ValueError in any function.
Overtime starts after 40 paid hours in a week.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Timesheet class to sheet.py: log(worker, day, start, end) records a shift, where day is "Mon" to "Sun" and start and end are minutes after midnight, and workers() returns the sorted list of workers. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): no shift is longer than 12 hours: log raises ValueError for a longer shift and records nothing.

Design decision for this project: overtime is paid at 1.5 times the hourly rate.

Design decision for this project: each line of a report is a worker and their paid hours as a decimal number, in the form Ann - 41.5 h.

given.handoff: Session 2 added Timesheet.log and workers with tests.
decisions: No shift is longer than 12 hours: log raises ValueError and records nothing.
Overtime is paid at 1.5 times the hourly rate.
A report line is the worker and paid hours as a decimal: Ann - 41.5 h.

sessions.prompt:
Add Timesheet.minutes(worker) to sheet.py: the worker's total paid minutes. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): overtime is paid at 1.25 times the hourly rate, not 1.5.

Design decision for this project: a shift that overlaps another shift of the same worker on the same day raises ValueError and is not recorded (a shift may start when another ends).

Design decision for this project: a shift longer than 6 hours has 30 unpaid minutes taken off its paid time.

decisions: Supersedes 1.5: overtime is paid at 1.25 times the hourly rate.
A shift overlapping another of the same worker on the same day raises ValueError (touching is allowed).
A shift longer than 6 hours has 30 unpaid minutes taken off.

sessions.prompt:

The plan for worker_days has one more step: the days must be in week order, Mon first. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): overtime starts after 38 paid hours in a week, not 40.

given.handoff: Session 4 added worker_days(sheet, worker) with tests. Its last step is left for later: week order, Mon first.
decisions: Supersedes 40 hours: overtime starts after 38 paid hours in a week.
